title: He was born in Moradabad. Now he runs Apple's entire global operation.

sources.text: The Week - Relatives upbeat over elevation of Moradabad-born Sabih Khan as Apple COO
Storyboard18 - Who is Sabih Khan - Apple's new Indian-origin COO? The Moradabad-born supply chain master

caption:
He was born in Moradabad. Now he runs Apple's entire global operation.

Born in 1966 in Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh, he joined Apple in 1995 after working at GE Plastics, becoming Senior Vice President of Operations in 2019 before the COO promotion.

Tim Cook called him 'a brilliant strategist' and one of the central architects of Apple's supply chain - the system that builds and moves hundreds of millions of devices a year.

Khan's three-decade climb from engineer to COO is a reminder that operational excellence, not just software, is where Indian-origin leaders are now setting the global standard.
